title: Four-stroke engine
prompt: a single-cylinder four-stroke petrol engine on a stand: turn the key to crank, it runs through intake, compression, power, exhaust; throttle up; see-through shows the piston, crankshaft, connecting rod, camshaft, valves, spark plug, carburettor and flywheel
blurb: A single-cylinder petrol engine on a test stand that you start with a key and throttle up, with a see-through view of the piston, crank, cam, valves and spark going through intake, compression, power and exhaust.
